recipes.name: Vegan French Toast
instructions: In a wide, shallow bowl, whisk together all the batter ingredients.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Dip the bread slices into the batter, letting them soak for a few seconds before flipping to coat the other side. Let any excess batter drip off, or gently wipe it off if needed.
Place the soaked bread slices in the pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until golden. Flip and cook on the other side for another 2 to 3 minutes.
Flip again and cook for about 1 minute per side to crisp the outside further. Add more oil between batches as needed.
Remove from the pan and serve with your favourite toppings. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Stale bread is preferred, otherwise the toasts get too soggy, especially in the middle.
Storage Best if enjoyed immediately. Keep leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
